# G12's note with the budget lowered to 8 bytes: the title's 6 fit, and 6 + 4 > 8 at the target's length word.

type note
breaks 5.2, point 9.2
expect BudgetExceeded test.note
offset 16
extent none
budget 8
requests test.note.title:6
